verdict.rationale: Oneleet's own marketing says the platform lets you score risks and connect them to controls. The public API spec also carries risk-assessment fields, which suggests a native risk assessment feature. Only the scoring and control-linkage parts of the story are evidenced, and only by a single marketing line plus an API field note. missing for 10: treatment plans, risk owners/assignment, periodic review cycles, in-depth first-party risk register docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: Score what could go wrong and connect it to the controls that answer it.
Overview of how the risk assessment was personalized, retained for backward compatibility with results generated before riskAssessmentSummary was introduced.
